title: The monoidal category of bimodule objects over a fixed monoid
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a monoidal category with associator $\alpha$ and with coequalizers, and suppose $X\otimes-$ and $-\otimes X$ preserve colimits for every object $X$. Let $A$ be a monoid object of $\mathcal C$, with multiplication $\mu$ and unit $\eta$. An $A$-$A$-bimodule is a left $A$-module object as in [sk-def-sfb-module-objects] equipped with a unital associative right action commuting with the left action. A bimodule morphism is a morphism of $\mathcal C$ commuting with both actions. Write $\operatorname{Bimod}_A(\mathcal C)$ for this category. It has a monoidal structure with tensor product
$$
P\otimes_A Q=\operatorname{coeq}\bigl((P\otimes A)\otimes Q
\mathrel{\substack{\xrightarrow{\rho_P\otimes Q}\\[-2pt]\xrightarrow{(P\otimes\gamma_Q)\circ\alpha_{P,A,Q}}}}P\otimes Q\bigr),
$$
where $\gamma_U$ and $\rho_U$ denote the left and right actions of any bimodule $U$, respectively. The induced left action is through $P$, and the induced right action is through $Q$; on morphisms the tensor is induced by the ambient tensor of the underlying maps. The unit is the regular bimodule $A$, with both actions $\mu$. For any third bimodule $L$, the associator is induced from the ambient associator on $(P\otimes Q)\otimes L$, and the left and right unitors are induced by the left and right action maps. These isomorphisms are natural and satisfy the pentagon and triangle identities.
